51348133.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to SET7 (unknown origin) by SPR analysis

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: Then, we evaluated the binding ability of compound 2-79 to SET7 by surface plasmon resonance (SPR) assays. The equilibrium dissociation constant (Kd) value of compound 2-79 was 29.00 μM, which was consistent with the detected inhibitory activity in AlphaLISA assays (Fig. S1). All in all, these biophysical and biochemical evidence demonstrated that compound 2-79 can bind to SET7 and inhibit it in vitro.
original_paragraph.Figure 2 caption: Fig. 2. Biophysical and biochemical validation of compound DC21. (A) Chemical structure of compound DC21. (B) IC50 curve of compound DC21 against SET7 by AlphaLISA. (C) Binding ability of compound DC21 to SET7 by SPR assay. (D) Inhibitory activities of compound DC21 to other enzymes at 100 μM.
original_paragraph.SPR Analysis: SPR assay was implemented. The Kd value of compound DC21 was 18.00 μM, which is basically the same as the result of the in vitro enzyme activity experiment (Fig. 2C).
original_paragraph.Figure 2C description: The sensorgram in Figure 2C shows the response units (RU) over time for compound DC21 binding to SET7 at various concentrations: 6.29 μM, 7.86 μM, 9.83 μM, 12.29 μM, 15.36 μM, 19.20 μM, 24.00 μM, and 30.00 μM. The x-axis represents time in seconds (from -50 to 450 s), and the y-axis represents Response Unit (RU) from 0 to 20. The Kd value is indicated as 18.00 μM.
